source: tools/monster_report.py: real per-frame routine $C0:B08C on a ZSNES v143 state, monster 3 in slot 3 (see docs/monster-3.md); frames are 60.0988 Hz video frames

commands.source: ai_cmds.measure: one command issued at the first AI step after the spawn; flag byte = requested frames (0 = natural length of the animation)

reaction.rule: see docs: reaction code 8 (anim 0x88) when damage <= max HP / 4, else 9 (anim 0x89); stun counter obj+0x1B4 = max(6, damage >> 3) combat ticks

drops_check.note: orb counters set so that no orb drop is replaced; contents of the rows are in docs/rom-combat.md section 13
